visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a white projection screen displaying event information in Traditional Chinese text. Minimalist orange and blue icons of a person, solar panels, and wind turbines are visible on the screen. The setting appears to be a brightly lit indoor venue. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of two women at a white table. A woman with short dark hair in a green top and black blazer is seated, writing a message inside a book. A second woman with long brown hair, wearing a floral-patterned dress, stands beside her, leaning in and smiling broadly while watching the writing process. In the background, rows of books on shelves and the projection screen are visible. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the inner title page of the book. Handwritten black ink text, including a dedication "Dear 沁宜," a signature "怡君," and the date "2025.10.4," is clearly visible over the printed book title. (4) The final segment is a still photograph of the two women standing together. The woman in the floral dress holds the signed book, while the woman in the blazer holds a bouquet of flowers. They are both smiling directly at the camera in front of the bookstore backdrop.
